figures.alt: Framed garage-conversion wall with insulation, flashed window opening, and protected electrical box
figures.caption: Plan the conversion as a wall, insulation, electrical, and weather-control assembly before finishes begin. A garage becomes living space only when its structure and building systems are coordinated.

figures.alt: Concrete garage floor with a contained crack-preparation area before a finish is installed
figures.caption: Inspect the slab, moisture conditions, and level changes before covering the floor. Cosmetic finishes cannot solve movement, water entry, or a floor that needs a different repair scope.

figures.alt: Clean sectional garage door at a Florida home's driveway
figures.caption: Decide whether the existing garage opening will be retained, enclosed, or rebuilt as part of the envelope. Exterior changes need a coherent weather, framing, and permitting plan rather than a finish-only decision.
